title: This week
body:
Softmax

- For 49 scores per row: standalone core uses 432 ALMs, 0 DSPs and 1 M10K (8192 bits), excluding packed readback logic.
- Measured on DE1-SoC: HPS INT8 5.404 µs; HPS FP32 12.715 µs; FPGA fabric INT8 5.088 µs — a 5.8% latency reduction vs HPS INT8. Board timing includes HPS launch, polling and output readback. RTL projects 228 cycles / 3.04 µs at 75 MHz.
- Fabric and HPS INT8 outputs matched 100% across 23520 tested bytes. INT8 output relative RMSE vs FP32: 6.56%. Top-1 predictions matched FP32 on 3/3 validation images.

LayerNorm

- For 192 channels per token: isolated canvas uses 949 ALMs, 13 DSPs and 6 M10Ks (22016 bits).
- Measured on DE1-SoC: HPS INT8 40.487 µs with exact correction or 157.588 µs with integer division; HPS FP32 7.751 µs; FPGA fabric INT8 6.362 µs — an 84.3% latency reduction vs HPS INT8 exact correction. Board timing includes HPS launch and polling, averaged over 24-token batches with in-place writeback. RTL projects 472 cycles / 6.29 µs at 75 MHz.
- Fabric and HPS INT8 outputs matched 100% across 55296 tested bytes. INT8 output relative RMSE vs FP32: 3.49%. Top-1 predictions matched FP32 on 3/3 validation images.
- Top-1 agreement measures prediction agreement with FP32, not dataset-wide classification accuracy. These operator benchmarks do not establish full-model end-to-end speedup. Earlier per-image projections are superseded; full table and CSV: ECE496 Files & Data (https://vit-fpga-wiki.pages.dev/#/files).
